main.description: The HappyView-specific half of a release, carried at extensions['at.happyproto.plugin.releaseExtension']. It is the plugin manifest, moved into the signed record so a consent screen renders without downloading the module. It is not trusted: the loader checks it against the module's plugin_info export and its import section, so a release that misstates what its WASM does is refused exactly as a checksum mismatch is.

pluginType.description: Every type requires an api_version of '2' or later and must declare its capabilities; there is no lower-version fallback for any of them.

apiVersion.description: '2' or later, as validate_manifest already requires.

namespace.description: Libraries only: the require() name, which is unique across installed plugins.

languageId.description: Interpreters only: what scripts.script_type holds. Lowercase alphanumerics plus '-' and '_', starting with a letter, because the value has to survive a column, a URL and an editor mode name.

capabilities.description: The trust contract. The loader cross-checks it against the module's actual imports, so a plugin cannot import what this does not cover.

allowedHosts.description: Hosts an outbound request may reach, as in today's manifest. The one constraint the capability model already has.
